keyEvents.text: First Half begins.
Delay in match because of an injury Taylor Calheira (Sporting Kansas City).
Delay in match because of an injury Pedro Soma (San Diego).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Sporting Kansas City. Rubén Ramos replaces Taylor Calheira because of an injury.
First Half ends, San Diego 0, Sporting Kansas City 0.
Second Half begins San Diego 0, Sporting Kansas City 0.
Marcus Ingvartsen (San Diego) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, San Diego. Jeppe Tverskov replaces Pedro Soma.
Substitution, San Diego. Gabriel Pirani replaces Alejandro Alvarado.
Substitution, San Diego. Amahl Pellegrino replaces Bryan Zamblé.
Lasse Berg Johnsen (Sporting Kansas City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Manu Duah (San Diego) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Sporting Kansas City. Justin Reynolds replaces Lasse Berg Johnsen.
Substitution, San Diego. David Mimbang replaces Onni Valakari.
Substitution, San Diego. David Vazquez replaces Marcus Ingvartsen.
Justin Reynolds (Sporting Kansas City) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Christopher McVey (San Diego) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! San Diego 0, Sporting Kansas City 1. André Luiz (Sporting Kansas City) converts the penalty with a left footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Sporting Kansas City. Jayden Reid replaces Capita.
Substitution, Sporting Kansas City. Shapi Suleymanov replaces Stephen Afrifa.
